title: Advancing science & engineering with Antigravity's /teamwork
why: Google Research official post on Antigravity's /teamwork multi-agent harness: workflows are declarative self-improving natural-language patterns routed per prompt; /boost is a solve-and-verify loop refined from prior trajectories; teams write custom specs from past run transcripts to improve harness patterns. One campaign analyzed trajectories and changed /boost from parallel splits to sequential implement-and-revise for tightly coupled code — explicitly a harness optimizing another harness (no weight training of the agent models).
mechanism: Retained non-weight harness edits: NL pattern library + prompt routing; /boost packaged from /teamwork's iterative coding pattern and refined from run transcripts (sequential vs parallel stages); new rewrite pattern (dependency-scheduled ports against unmodified tests); DuoDiscover constructs proxy 'yardstick' evaluators continuously validated against full hardware runs (Kendall's tau). Independent critics/auditors run from clean contexts.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported (blog, not a controlled harness ablation): /boost improved on coding tasks after the trajectory-derived sequential-vs-parallel change (token-efficiency claim). Downstream: Courtade–Kumar formalized in Lean 4 (~50M lines); LEAP formalizations (e.g. Weil conjectures ~1.8M lines / 28,800 subagent invocations); NMR structure task 95% top-1 / 100% top-3 on complex benchmark molecules; 9x9 Go hill-climb ~2,600 Elo in <8 days to 1,885 Elo; DuoDiscover 4.09x geomean speedup on 17 JAXBench kernels and 2.99x on 7 vLLM TPU-Inference Pallas kernels; Rust libgav1 port 20–30% faster than original C++/assembly after profile-guided /teamwork; Borg scheduling workflow shipped 2 changes with a 24% reduction in TPU-workload preemption on some hardware. Deep Review author survey N=70 (90% mostly/almost-all factual; >30% caught substantive proof bugs).
evidence_locator: Google Research blog dated November 13, 2026 (RSS pubDate Fri, 13 Nov 2026 20:47:18 +0000), byline Vahab Mirrokni. Methods: 'Scaling long-horizon reasoning' (self-improving patterns, routing, /boost refined from prior trajectories, custom specs from run transcripts). Systems: 'Autonomous hill climbing'; 'Memory-safe Rust rewrites, /boost, and TPU kernel optimization' (harness-optimizing-harness sentence; DuoDiscover yardsticks). Also 'Scaling formal verification…', 'Molecular chemistry discovery', 'Google infrastructure applications'.
retrieval_notes: Primary official blog opened in full (HTML+extracted text) during the 2026-11-14 collect. No dedicated arXiv ID for the /teamwork system itself; in-post arXiv links are mostly domain result papers (math/systems) and were not re-backfilled. No official /teamwork or /boost code repo located (linked GitHubs are result-specific).
